title: the critic defers IN-RS-CODE-001 and -002 to clippy, but no gate's clippy runs needless_pass_by_value or redundant_clone anywhere, or the restriction lints outside intentsvcs and intent-cli
body:
Raised by molt-vc on 2026-10-25 from conflab-cc's measurement against each Rust rule's `critic_tool_codes`, and narrowed for Intent by vc against `.github/workflows/rust.yml` the same day; filed by vc.

## What happens

The headless critic reports the three clippy-armed Rust rules as `ARMED but NOT RUN HERE`, so a judge's critic leg defers them to clippy. A judge then reads a green clippy leg as covering them. For two of the lints that rely on this, no Intent gate runs clippy with them enabled:

- `IN-RS-CODE-002` (ownership before clone) names `clippy::clone_on_copy`, `clippy::needless_pass_by_value` and `clippy::redundant_clone`. Default clippy with `-D warnings` enforces `clone_on_copy` only. `needless_pass_by_value` is in the pedantic group and `redundant_clone` in nursery, and neither CI step nor any judge leg enables them.
- `IN-RS-CODE-001` (result over panic) names `unwrap_used`, `expect_used` and `panic`, restriction lints. CI's second clippy step enables them for `-p intentsvcs -p intent-cli --lib` only, so the `intentd` and `testkit` crates' library code is covered by nothing.
- `IN-RS-CODE-005` is enforced by default clippy and is not affected.

So a judge record reading "critic: 001, 002, 005 ARMED but NOT RUN HERE" beside "clippy 0" overstates what was judged.

## Expected

Every lint a rule names in `critic_tool_codes` is either run by some gate (CI and the judge's clippy legs) over the code the rule reaches, or is not claimed as clippy-answered.

## Options, for the owner to measure and choose

1. Enable the lints where the rule reaches: add `-W clippy::needless_pass_by_value -W clippy::redundant_clone` (as deny) to the workspace clippy step, and widen the restriction step to `intentd` and `testkit`. Measure first how many findings each lint raises today, since clippy stops at the first failing crate (count with `-W`).
2. Drop from `critic_tool_codes` any lint no gate runs, so the census names the rule unanswerable instead of deferring it to a clippy that never asks.

Judge: the workspace clippy legs, the critic arms that read the census, CI's rust.yml steps. Owner: open; not before 3.2.7's cut unless hv asks.


DEFERRED PAST 3.2.7 (hv, 2026-10-28, first-hand in vc's session, before vc's clock read of 18:02Z). vc rated this issue P3, defer past 3.2.7, in a review of all open work, and hv answered, verbatim: "I agree with everything except:", naming other items. Decision 76 takes every open issue into 3.2.7 unless hv defers it by name. This is that deferral, recorded on the issue as 76(4) asks. The issue stays open and low.


DEFERRAL CONFIRMED (hv, 2026-10-29, first-hand in vc's session before vc's clock read of 16:14Z: "Ok, go with molt-vc's rec. I stand corrected." molt-vc's recommendation took 0662, 0660, 0659 and 0651 into 3.2.7 and kept 0650, 0661 and 0649 deferred). This issue stays deferred past 3.2.7, as 76(4) asks.



RESOLVED FOR 3.3.0 (cc built it to vc's ruling of 2026-11-10, under hv's pen; judged by vc in the train 0665, 0670, 0649). Measured first, in a desk slot on 2026-11-10, each lint run as a warning so every crate reports, unique sites only: in library and binary code, needless_pass_by_value 22 and redundant_clone 14; IN-RS-CODE-001's lints outside CI's library step 0 in intentd's own source, 3 in its build script's shared version_parity.rs, and 12 in testkit.

WHAT THE RULES NOW COVER.
- IN-RS-CODE-001: CI's library step (`cargo clippy -p intentsvcs -p intent-cli --lib -- -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic`) and a new step over intentd's binary (`cargo clippy -p intentd --bins -- -D ...` the same three). Devbin twin `bin/devbin check panics-intentd`. intentd's build script carries the crate-level allow intent-cli's build script already had (vc, 2026-09-15): a build script's panic fails the build.
- IN-RS-CODE-002: `clone_on_copy` by default clippy, as before, and `needless_pass_by_value` by a new CI step over library and binary code (`cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins -- -D clippy::needless_pass_by_value`). Devbin twin `bin/devbin check ownership`. All 22 sites were dealt with: 17 now borrow, or their type is Copy (Template, Mutation, SearchDoor), and 5 error adapters that `Result::map_err` must hand their error by value carry `#[allow(clippy::needless_pass_by_value, reason = ...)]`.
- The cut gate (bin/.devbin/cut/gate) runs all six devbin twins, and tests/unit/devbin_rust_gates.bats holds each CI cargo line to its twin.

WHAT THEY LEAVE OUT, ON PURPOSE.
- redundant_clone is no longer one of IN-RS-CODE-002's tool codes. It is in clippy's nursery group, unstable and with known false positives, and a gate that moves with the nursery is not one to trust (vc). All 14 sites it raised in library and binary code were real redundant clones, and all 14 are fixed. No gate runs it.
- Tests and colocated #[cfg(test)] code stay outside both rules' steps: a test's panic is its failure signal.
- testkit stays outside IN-RS-CODE-001: it is a test-support crate whose panic is how the calling test fails, and the rule's When This Does Not Apply now says so.
